before: The operator CLI accepted producer revision but no reviewed target/source/embedding identity. A separate preflight could become stale before the actual publisher capture or collection initialization.
after: Operator writes require target identity. Publish additionally requires expected catalog and embedding identity. Target is checked before Milvus client construction; actual source capture is checked before embeddings, registry reservation and index writes.
actual_environment_finding: Current Redis has AOF disabled and no automatic RDB schedule; this is retained under existing C-02 as a durable-publication blocker. No persistence policy or production configuration change is inferred.
review_checks: Existing public HTTP/SSE and V1 paths untouched
Internal publisher callers remain compatible when no reviewed candidate is supplied
CLI multi-domain rejection precedes all clients
Successful guarded publication still verifies full inventory, source freshness and pin.finish
Existing registry CAS/immutable generation handling and fail-closed missing-marker behavior unchanged
Operator expected identities are preconditions, not an authentication/authorization implementation
Exact snapshot/target/config hashes disclose no credentials, locators, raw catalog rows or business values
limitations: Guards do not prove Redis persistence, deployment owner, trusted caller or storage durability
No native embedding/publication, restart or failover was executed
Observed target state may change; native collection/marker/Redis preconditions require fresh read before approved operations
SQL loopback transient retained with two passing independent reruns and final complete pass; precise cause remains unknown
